title: Insulin action times

findings.title: Degludec's 42-hour figure is a lower bound
findings.problem: "Degludec about 42 hours" reads as an approximate offset time. Tresiba labeling reports glucose-lowering activity lasting at least 42 hours after the last dose under the studied steady-state conditions.
findings.fix: Use "degludec: at least 42 hours in labeling studies," retaining the qualification that action varies. Do not imply that its effect ends at hour 42.

findings.where: Images 9–13 and 15, curves crossing amber peak bands; Curve() peak-band fillOpacity
findings.title: Dark peak overlays miss the project's contrast target
findings.problem: The dark-theme accent curve (#8CDCC8) over the 55%-opacity amber band has approximately 3.2:1 contrast, not the 4.5:1 claimed in the source comment and required by the project. This is a project-target failure; non-text graphics ordinarily have a 3:1 accessibility threshold.
findings.fix: Reduce the dark-theme band opacity or change its treatment, then measure curve-to-background contrast across the actual composited fills. Keep the caution window distinguishable without reducing curve contrast below the specified target.

assessment: Two minor corrections: the degludec duration qualifier and dark-theme peak-overlay contrast.
